{{Top}}
A '''monocular''' was a lensed device that allowed the user to see things clearly from a distance. [[Hailey LaMelle]] used a monocular to spy on [[Prefect (Galactic Empire)|Prefect]] [[Gerom]] meeting with the racketeer [[Dasar Zorm]].
